basics.description: An hourly Logic App that ranks the CVEs affecting your tenant with Vulnder and writes one row per CVE to the `Vulnder_CL` table in a Log Analytics workspace: one you have, or a new one made here. The Logic App goes in the resource group you choose here, in the workspace's region. [Setup guide](https://github.com/fullymiddleaged/vulnder/blob/main/docs/AZURE.md)

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: For a new workspace and a new resource group. With a workspace you have, the Logic App goes in its region instead.

basics.name: workspaceChoice
basics.label: Log Analytics workspace
basics.toolTip: Vulnder writes its rows to a Log Analytics workspace. Use your Sentinel workspace if you have one.

basics.name: newWorkspaceName
basics.label: New workspace name
basics.toolTip: Created in the resource group and region above. With the Sentinel rule ticked under Settings, Sentinel is turned on for it.

constraints.validationMessage: 4 to 63 letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

basics.name: workspace
basics.label: Workspace
basics.toolTip: The workspace for the Vulnder_CL table, and the Sentinel workspace if you use Sentinel. It can be in another resource group.

options.text: Pick the workspace above. If you don't have one, choose Create a new one.

basics.name: mode
basics.label: Where the CVEs come from
basics.toolTip: Pick by licence. Every mode writes the same rows.

allowedValues.label: Defender
allowedValues.description: Defender Vulnerability Management's open CVEs. Needs Defender for Endpoint Plan 2, the standalone licence, or Defender for Servers.

allowedValues.label: Intune
allowedValues.description: Intune's discovered apps, matched to CVE records by Vulnder.

allowedValues.label: Stack
allowedValues.description: A stack you write once, such as firewalls, VPNs and appliances.

basics.name: stack
basics.label: Stack
basics.toolTip: Easier: describe your stack at vulnder.com and use Deploy to Azure on the results, which fills this in. Here, it takes Vulnder's stack format, comma-separated. Needed for mode Stack; in modes Defender and Intune it's optional, and ranked alongside for what they can't see.

validations.message: Mode Stack needs a stack. Describe it at vulnder.com and use Deploy to Azure on the results.

elements.name: sentinelRules
elements.label: Create the Sentinel analytics rule "Vulnder: new Act now CVE"
elements.toolTip: Opens one incident per CVE the first hour it is Act now. On a new workspace this turns Sentinel on; on one you have, Sentinel must already be on.

elements.name: days
elements.label: Window for new CVEs
elements.toolTip: CVEs Defender lists are ranked whatever their age.

elements.name: name
elements.label: Name
elements.toolTip: Names the Logic App and its data collection rule, and fills the Source column. To add a second mode to the same workspace, deploy again with another name.

constraints.validationMessage: 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

elements.name: vulnderUrl
elements.label: Vulnder URL
elements.toolTip: Change this only if you run your own Vulnder deployment.

constraints.validationMessage: An https:// address with no path, such as https://vulnder.com.

options.text: After deployment, grant the Logic App's managed identity the Microsoft Graph permission for this mode: ThreatHunting.Read.All for Defender, DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All for Intune. Runs before the grant write nothing.
